Reachable keeps an element that an inline style hides, and never a script

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"hidden_content\":\"Reachable\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">collapsed body<script>var code = 1;</script></div>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
